title: Vibrant Spicy Turkish Bulgur Kisir
description: A spicy and flavorful Turkish dish made with bulgur, featuring cider vinegar and a slow-cook method, suitable for diabetic-friendly diets. This shaggy weeknight dish is perfect for a quick and healthy meal.
instructions: Rinse the bulgur in a fine mesh sieve and drain well.
In a large saucepan, bring the water to a boil, then add the bulgur, cover, and reduce heat to low.
Simmer for 15 minutes or until the bulgur is tender and the water is absorbed.
In a large bowl, whisk together the cider vinegar, olive oil, tomato paste, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked bulgur to the bowl and stir until the bulgur is well coated with the dressing.
Stir in the chopped onion and parsley.
Let the kisir sit at room temperature for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the kisir at room temperature or chilled.
Garnish with additional parsley if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
